Flanking.Label: Flanking
Flanking.Tooltip: +2 to attack rolls when flanking the target.

Prone.Label: Prone
Prone.Tooltip: -4 to melee attack rolls, +4 against you in melee.

Squeezing.Label: Squeezing
Squeezing.Tooltip: -4 to attack rolls while squeezing through a tight space.

HighGround.Label: High Ground
HighGround.Tooltip: +1 to melee attack rolls from higher elevation.

Charge.Label: Charge
Charge.Tooltip: +2 to the attack roll, -2 AC until your next turn.

DefensiveFighting.Label: Fight Defensively
DefensiveFighting.Tooltip: -4 to the attack roll, +2 AC until your next turn.

Proficient.Label: Proficient
Proficient.Tooltip: Uncheck if not proficient with this weapon (-4 to the attack roll).

NonLethal.Label: Non-lethal
NonLethal.Tooltip: Deal subdual damage instead of normal damage.

Charged.Label: Charged
Charged.Tooltip: This creature charged on its last turn and is at -2 AC until its next turn.

FlatFooted.Label: Flat-Footed
FlatFooted.Tooltip: Flat-footed creatures lose their Dex bonus to AC and can't make AoOs.

TotalDefense.Label: Total Defense
TotalDefense.Tooltip: This creature used its standard action for Total Defense this round: +4 AC until its next turn.

DefensiveFightingActive.Label: Defensive Fighting
DefensiveFightingActive.Tooltip: This creature fought defensively on its last attack and is at +2 AC until its next turn.

ApplyHalfDamage.Label: Apply Half Damage
ApplyHalfDamage.Tooltip: Halves the final applied damage (e.g. Evasion-adjacent effects).

IgnoreCriticalHit.Label: Ignore Critical Hit
IgnoreCriticalHit.Tooltip: This creature is immune to critical hits (e.g. undead, constructs, oozes).

WieldMode.Label: Wield Mode
WieldMode.MismatchNotInMainHand: Attacked with the primary hand, but this weapon isn't equipped there.
WieldMode.MismatchNotInOffHand: Attacked with the off-hand, but this weapon isn't equipped there.
WieldMode.MismatchOffHandOccupied: Attacked two-handed, but the off-hand is holding something else.
WieldMode.InsufficientBab: Attacked with no Base Attack Bonus remaining in that hand.

COMBAT.NoActionAvailable: No action available for this attack.
COMBAT.ChargeMeleeOnly: A charge permits only a single melee attack.
COMBAT.NoTargets: This action normally requires a target.
COMBAT.TooManyTargets: This action allows at most {max} target(s).
COMBAT.TargetTooCloseForReach: {target} is too close to attack with a reach weapon.
COMBAT.MissingTargetToken: Unable to determine token positions for this attack.
COMBAT.NotYourTurnToDefend: Only the GM (or, if allowed, the target's owner) can resolve this attack.

Maneuver.MustBeInCombat: Total Defense requires an active encounter.
